description:
Build an agent on the server from the business's website_url (its pages become the agent's knowledge base, its colour and tone the mascot), a description, or both, and the role it plays, e.g. "receptionist". Takes up to a minute; this tool waits for it and returns the finished agent (mascot.status ready, or failed with mascot.error; a failed build leaves the agent with the default mascot). Charged for the model tokens it spends. One build at a time per account, and builds from a website or description are rate limited. Also needs knowledge_bases:write when a website is given.

Requires scope `agents:write`.

description.description: e.g. "A calm receptionist for a dental clinic in Kochi. Teal."

name.description: What the agent calls itself. Without it, the generator picks a name.

role.description: receptionist, support, sales, guide, or your own words.

website_url.description: The business's website. Read once, not stored.

name: generate_agent
title: Generate an agent
